The '''Valnoos system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Morshdine sector/Legends|Morshdine sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The system contained the [[planet]] [[Valnoos/Legends|Valnoos]].
